english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a parcel, box, or envelope that has been sent or received.
This is the all-purpose choice for a wrapped package being sent or transported.

examples.english: I just received the package you sent.
examples.traditional: 我啱啱收到你寄嚟嘅包裹。

examples.english: This parcel is being sent to you.
